legacy_coverage_issue.old_rule: nonempty accepted airport subset with IATA and scheduled_service flag within60km => complete
legacy_coverage_issue.finding: The engineering distance cutoff does not prove an exhaustive city-serving passenger-airport roster. OurAirports flag alone is not an operational timetable.
legacy_coverage_issue.future_ingestion: partial if at least one airport is accepted, otherwise unknown; official source closure requires separate review

proposed_category_membership.criterion: Officially identified passenger airports serving the city, including airports outside its municipal boundary.

facts.locator: Page heading and first paragraph of main article
facts.fact: The regional TIC identifies Khrabrovo as the only passenger airport in Kaliningrad Region and directly describes travel from Kaliningrad.
facts.supports: Exhaustive regional passenger-airport assertion and city service, independent of60km geometry.

facts.fact: The publisher identifies itself as АНО КО «Туристский информационный центр Калининградской области» and lists this domain as its official page.
facts.supports: Publisher identity, not roster closure alone.

facts.fact: The charter identifies Kaliningrad Region, represented by its Ministry of Culture and Tourism, as the founder.
facts.supports: Authority of the regional tourism publisher.
facts.inspection: PDF rendered and visually inspected; no claim of cryptographic signature verification.

facts.fact: The regional ministry established the TIC and assigned tourist information services as its primary activity.

facts.locator: PDFp1, Северо-ЗападноеМТУ, row8; p9 helicopter section
facts.fact: The complete national civil registry dated09.11.2026 lists Калининград(Храброво), registration№109 dated02.02.2015, operatorАО«Аэропорт«Храброво», classБ. The separate state-complexYantar entry is under heliports.

facts.fact: Калининград(Храброво) is explicitly classified as the airport of a regional administrative center and an international airport.
facts.supports: Official Kaliningrad city-service designation, outside municipal-boundary restriction.

facts.fact: The operator page reports10November2026 and scheduled passenger departures from Kaliningrad to SaintPetersburg and Moscow.
facts.supports: Observed current passenger-flight operation; no travel time or frequency fed into accessibility weights.
facts.limitations: Web extraction may be cached. DirectHTTP13,602-byte spinner is not used as board evidence.

scope_questions_for_independent_reviewer: The TIC exhaustiveness assertion is regional. Together with federal city designation, does it close the product roster of officially city-serving passenger airports?
The proof does not assert that every foreign airport a Kaliningrad resident might use is officially serving Kaliningrad. No foreign airport is excluded merely by60km distance.
The published TIC page is undated; registry publication is09.11.2026 and operator observation is10.11.2026. Validity must remain explicit.

policy.component_selection: maximum sum of metric way lengths; equal totals choose smallest union-component root
policy.nearest_way_policy: minimum metric point-to-way distance; ties within1e-3m choose smallest numeric OSM way ID
policy.offset_policy: round(projected along-way offset in metres,1), then interpolate on selected metric way
policy.stored_coordinate_policy: inverse-project then round longitude and latitude to7decimal places

existing_designated_access_policy.meaning: Complete only for existing versioned designated-access model, not all real-world doors.

promotion_requirements: Independent reviewer accepts exact category membership and source identity binding.
Any revised accepted coverage/source set uses a new immutable snapshot; published originals remain unchanged.
Final weighted receipt binds official roster evidence and exact existing designated-access policy to accepted source/build/profile/native endpoint identities.
ML1 engine validates exact weighted minimum; no standalone ML2-computed index is a product output.
